name: remote-focused-session-ending-returns-focus-to-all
description: Two remote sessions are working and the focus is on alpha. Alpha's session ends mid-turn: the focus returns to all sessions, the transcript notes both the focus change and the ended session, and the status stays thinking because beta is still working.
reason: A focus on a session that no longer exists would mute every reply and leave the status idle while another session works, with nothing on screen to explain why.
source: DESIGN.md v2.2 B 'Focus clears on control-mode switch and when the focused session ends'; AppState.handleRemoteEvent(.sessionEnd)

transcript.text: Focus → alpha — only this session is spoken now.
Focused session ended — back to hearing everything.
